body:
## Reproduce the Smallest Decisive Result

The full training run costs millions, but one ablation or evaluation can still test the central explanation.

Reproduction can mean rerunning released code, checking evaluation, or rebuilding a smaller experiment. Record environment, seeds, data versions, and deviations.

A failed reproduction is evidence only after checking implementation and scope. Share precise conditions rather than declaring the entire idea false.
common_mistakes: The newest paper is automatically the most reliable.
A title provides enough evidence for an engineering decision.
mini_exercise: Draw “Reproduce the Smallest Decisive Result” as three labeled steps, then explain the decision at each step.
real_world_usage: AI changes quickly, but engineering judgment depends on distinguishing durable evidence from headlines and benchmark noise.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Reproduce the Smallest Decisive Result,” explain Staying Current with AI Research without assuming the listener knows AI engineering.
